frozen_change_from_v4: When all candidates are governance-legal and inside calibration support, a practical performance tie retains the minimum analytic-cost candidate instead of replacing it with policy-first.
unchanged_components: V4 fitted rates and support bounds
holdout_rule: No final holdout timing or winner may be inspected before this protocol, code, model, configuration, hashes, and acceptance gates are committed.
failure_policy: Retain and report a failed final holdout. Do not tune V4.1 on final holdout answers or rerun a changed optimizer under the same final-holdout label.
paper_scope: A pass supports only the governed two-candidate checkpoint placement claim for the frozen 150K-row DuckDB real-month workload. It does not authorize broader optimizer, scale, or engine claims.
